Ever Prime Residences — KaronHillside coastal living on Phuket's west coast
A Modern Address Between Kata and Karon Beaches

Ever Prime Residences — Karon

Ever Prime Residences is a low-rise development set on a Karon hillside, with views across the sea, mountains and town. Four 8-storey buildings combine a resort atmosphere with everyday convenience, including a supermarket, café and workspace on site.

LocationKaron, Phuket's west coast · Kata Beach approx. 0.9 km
Scale492 residences · 4 buildings (A–D) · 8 floors · underground parking
Residence types1BR 32.89–44.84 sqm · 2BR 46.53–60.09 sqm · 4BR 176.35 sqm
AmenitiesOcean-view rooftop pool with bar, two lap pools, kids' pool, fitness, yoga, sauna, steam room, spa and beauty salon
On site24-hour Villa Market, café, co-working, business hub, library, squash court, golf simulator, games room and EV charging
Completion2028 · developer brochure specifies December 2028
PriceCurrent price list available from the Phuket Plus sales team

The Element by Anocha — KamalaContemporary residences in a peaceful Kamala setting
Mountain Tranquillity, Minutes from Kamala Beach

The Element by Anocha — Kamala

The Element is an exclusive community in a peaceful part of Kamala, away from busy roads yet just minutes from the beach, shops and restaurants. Four 7-storey buildings sit among landscaped gardens, with resort-level facilities designed for everyday living.

LocationKamala, Phuket's west coast · Kamala Beach approx. 5 minutes
Development278 residences · 4 buildings · 7 floors
Residences1- and 2-bedroom formats · 29.87–168.61 sqm · selected types with private pools
AmenitiesTwin pools, hot and cold plunge pools, rooftop tennis court, Muay Thai-style gym, fitness, yoga, sauna, co-kitchen, marketplace, business hub, beauty salon, kids' playground and 24-hour CCTV
ViewsForested mountain setting
HandoverQ2 2027
PriceFrom THB 3.94M on the official English project site · subject to current availability

The Trees Residence — BangtaoTropical hotel-managed residence concept
Tropical Wellness Living in Prestigious Bangtao

The Trees Residence — Bangtao

The Trees Residence is a modern tropical development in Bangtao, one of Phuket's most sought-after areas. Coastal proximity, a secluded green setting and an extensive wellness zone make it suitable both as a personal base and as a professionally managed residence.

LocationBangtao / Cherngtalay · Bangtao Beach approx. 10 minutes
Development296 residences across 17 buildings · 168 residences form the currently marketed Zone B
Residences1BR 37.28 sqm · 2BR 55.03 sqm
WellnessFitness centre, saunas, ice plunge, hot and cold baths, spa and massage rooms
Family & leisureChildren's playground, kids' club, open-air theatre, BBQ area, co-working and library
CompletionQ4 2028
Price1BR from THB 3.99M · 2BR from THB 6.05M
